findings.label: Sample chip aria-labels missing
findings.detail: Every .sample-chip button across the URL scanner, message analyzer, and email panels is missing an aria-label attribute. The spec required aria-label="Load sample: [description]" on each. Add descriptive aria-label to each chip button.

findings.label: msgLoaderSub ID missing from HTML
findings.detail: executeMessageScan calls document.getElementById('msgLoaderSub') but no element with that id exists in the HTML. The variable resolves to null so per-stage status text is never updated during scan. Add id="msgLoaderSub" to the <div class="loader-sub"> inside #msgScanLoader.

findings.label: Defense Benchmarks inline color override
findings.detail: .best-item icons in box-one/two/three carry style="color: #590b94", #9c6007, and #0d6e4b in both the main dashboard and mobile personal-bests sections, overriding design system token colors. Replace with design-token-driven utility classes.

findings.label: DEFCON pill missing role and aria-label
findings.detail:
DEFCON 2
has no role="status" or aria-label. Add role="status" aria-label="Current DEFCON level: 2" per spec.

findings.label: Table row striping absent
findings.detail: No tr:nth-child(even) rule is defined. The plan specified background: rgba(26,34,53,0.5) for alternating table rows. Hover is present; the dark-stripe part of the HIGH tables criterion is missing.

findings.label: Skeleton loaders on dashboard not implemented
findings.detail: Dashboard metric cards show -- as placeholder text while loadRealDashboardTelemetry resolves. No skeleton shimmer elements exist. This MEDIUM criterion was not addressed.
